Western Governors University is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build and support applications that improve the student experience and advance its higher education mission. The role works with experienced engineers and cross-functional partners on web applications, backend services, and technology initiatives, including exposure to cloud technologies and AI-assisted development.
Education
Universities
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Contribute to technology solutions that support WGU students and internal teams
Learn from a highly experienced engineering organization with strong mentorship opportunities
Gain exposure to modern software development practices, cloud technologies, and AI-assisted development tools
Build a strong foundation for long-term growth as a software engineer
Work on innovative technology initiatives that help expand access to education and student success
Assist in the design, development, testing, implementation, and support of software applications and services
Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and well-tested code with guidance from senior engineers
Translate business requirements into technical solutions and working software
Participate in code reviews, testing activities, and continuous improvement efforts
Identify risks, dependencies, and gaps in requirements and communicate them appropriately
Collaborate with engineers, product partners, and stakeholders across the organization
Support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of web applications and backend services
Attend company summits and team events as needed
Travel to conferences, company locations, and business-related meetings when required

Interest in full-stack development and learning new technologies, including Salesforce technologies
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with teammates and stakeholders
Curiosity, emotional intelligence, and a growth mindset
Ability to work successfully in both self-directed and team-based environments
Preferred
Experience with Java or a similar object-oriented programming language
Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
Exposure to Agile development practices, Git, Jira, cloud-native technologies, or AI-assisted development tools
